description: Match only the selected owner image drawing style. Do not copy its identity or clothing.

pose.portrait: neutral still portrait, head and torso facing viewer's right, shoulders level, no head tilt, no gestures
pose.full-body: neutral standing pose, feet planted, arms slightly separated from torso, hands visible, no action or individual gestures

camera.portrait: eye-level medium close-up, full head, both shoulders and upper chest visible, consistent scale, facing viewer's right; no waist, hands, tilt or gestures
camera.full-body: exactly one standing figure, eye-level front three-quarter neutral pose, entire head hands and feet visible; no turnaround, second view, inset, or detail panel

turntable.shared: full shot from top of head to soles of feet, neutral standing pose, eye-level camera, fixed scale, same lighting and plain background in every view; one figure per image

front.angle: exact front view, both eyes and both sides of outfit equally visible

profile.angle: exact side profile, one eye visible, nose and chin silhouette clear

side.angle: oblique side view between front and profile, front and side planes both visible

back.angle: exact back view, face not visible, back garment and hair silhouette clear

partViews.head: character face reference for the existing common body in the fixed head framing
partViews.upper: front orthographic, outer garment and collar only
partViews.lower: front orthographic, lower garment and waist only
partViews.equipment: individual approved equipment item on plain background

partCamera.background: solid light neutral background for Tripo input
partCamera.scale: consistent across parts for one character
partCamera.lighting: soft upper-left key with no dramatic shadows
